summary.headline: CSB Bank Q1 FY27 net profit rose 27% YoY to Rs.150 Crores, with NIM at 3.66% and ROA at 1.09%, but other income fell 7%.
summary.overview: CSB Bank reported Q1 FY27 net profit of Rs.150 Crores (+27% YoY) and operating profit of Rs.251 Crores (+14% YoY), with NII up 26% to Rs.479 Crores. Deposits grew 26% and advances 24% YoY, both ahead of industry, and CD ratio moved to just under 90%. Other income fell 7% YoY on lower treasury gains (Rs.12 Crores vs Rs.53 Crores) and weaker insurance and gold-linked processing fees. Management called Q1 the worst-case margin quarter and reiterated FY27 NIM of around 3.75% and ROA of 1.3%-1.5%.

financial_highlights.value: Rs.12 Crores treasury profit plus Rs.3 Crores trading profit (total other income down 7%)
Growth 24% YoY vs industry 18.6%; yield on advances 10.65%

segments.name: Gold loans
segments.commentary: About 54% of the loan book; yield 11.85% vs 12% QoQ. Management expects the gold mix to stay near 50% in FY27 and fall toward 30% by FY2030. Gold disbursements fell QoQ on regulatory implementation and reduced top-ups; the book was about Rs.21,000 Crores last quarter.

segments.name: Wholesale (WSB)
segments.commentary: About 26% of the book; growing 35%-40% per management. Target is about 32% of the book by FY2030. FIPS book fell to about one-third of WSB from about 70%.

segments.name: SME / BLG
segments.commentary: Yield fell to 9.25% from 9.81% QoQ. Slippages in the quarter; management is deliberately cautious and has raised credit appraisal bars for FY27.

segments.name: Retail (LAS / repledger)
segments.commentary: Repledger LAS book fell from over Rs.2,100 Crores to about Rs.60 Crores and will run off by next quarter, per RBI discontinuation from 1 April 2026. Unsecured retail is only about 2% of the book; focus deferred to FY2028.

segments.name: Treasury and fee income
segments.commentary: Treasury profit was Rs.12 Crores vs Rs.53 Crores a year ago, and insurance fees fell after tighter mis-selling controls. Management targets full-year fee income at 16%-17% of total income, with Q1 other income about 15% of income.

guidance_outlook: Full-year FY27 NIM guidance of around 3.75%; management said it sees no risk to this guidance.
Full-year FY27 ROA guidance of 1.3%-1.5%; management said it would not go below 1.3% this year and internal target is 1.5%.
ROE: started FY27 near 12%; aims to end FY27 above the FY26 exit of 14.14% and try to touch 15%.
Wholesale to grow 35%-40% and gold 30%-35% in FY27; gold mix expected near 50% this year.
CASA to grow in line with deposits from FY2028; CASA to outgrow term deposits from FY2029. FY27 CASA ratio expected to hold at about 19.4% only if deposits grow about 25%.
Fee income guidance of 16%-17% of total income for the full year, with insurance and gold disbursements expected to pick up from Q2.
Unsecured retail push deferred to FY2028; ECLGS disbursement so far about Rs.60 Crores.
capex_capacity: Network of 868 branches and 835 ATMs as on 30 June 2026.
Technology transformation complete: 50+ surrounding systems integrated with CBS, plus transaction banking and ServiceNow; some trade, supply chain and CMS systems to go live in the next 3-4 months.
New retail liability acquisition channel rolling out; retail deposit products launched last year, with sales team being built.
Technology was delayed by about two and a half years, per management, due to a decision delay rather than execution.
demand_pricing: Deposit growth 26% YoY vs industry 13.4%; bulk deposits about 52% of term deposits and about 40% of total deposits; retail about 48% of deposits.
Cost of funds around 6.5%; higher cost driven by bulk deposits, FCY borrowings and CDs, which management expects to ease as liquidity improves.
Q1 NIM hit by flow-through of end-March deposit costs, and by slippages and reduced recoveries; management says Q1 NIM is the worst case for the year.
Gold LTV around 75% vs peers below 65%, driven by agri gold (LTV up to 85%); non-agri LTV about 50%-55%. Board plans to gradually cut agri gold.
Deposit rates showing marginal softening; SME yields expected to improve next quarter as slippages are upgraded in Q2/Q3.

qa_highlights.question: Gold share at 54%, bulk deposits at 52% of term deposits; is the bulk mix the main NIM drag and what is the target?
qa_highlights.answer: Management confirmed the bulk mix (about 52% of term deposits) raises cost of funds (about 6.5%). Retail franchise build starts with CASA from FY2028; management expects no quick reduction in bulk share in FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Can a wholesale book funded by wholesale money hold margins, and how volatile are slippages?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said NIM and ROA guidance holds for the year; wholesale is being built as a franchise with ROA and RAROC targets. Q1 slippage about Rs.98 Crores (Q4 about Rs.60 Crores), mainly in BLG/SME, which management expects to be largely upgraded in Q2/Q3.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other income fall 7%?
qa_highlights.answer: Treasury profit was Rs.12 Crores vs Rs.53 Crores a year ago, insurance fees were cut after mis-selling controls, and gold/retail processing fees fell with lower disbursements. Management expects recovery from Q2.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 ROA guidance being revised from around 1.5%?
qa_highlights.answer: No. Management said it will not go below 1.3% for FY27, with an internal 1.5% target; the 1.3% comment answered a different question on the year-end run-rate.

qa_highlights.question: What is the impact of IDBI Bank stake sale by promoter Fairfax?
qa_highlights.answer: CSB has had no discussions on this. Fairfax told management to continue business as usual; the bank is run by its own management.

qa_highlights.question: Why did gold disbursements fall sharply QoQ?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited regulatory implementation (end-use monitoring), fewer top-ups as gold prices stopped rising, and the repledger LAS run-off. Disbursements are expected to pick up as gold prices rise.

qa_highlights.question: What is the ECLGS disbursement and what is the growth guidance for corporate and gold?
qa_highlights.answer: ECLGS disbursements about Rs.60 Crores so far. Management guided wholesale at 35%-40% growth and gold at 30%-35% for FY27.

risks_watch: Asset quality volatility: slippages of about Rs.98 Crores in Q1 vs Rs.60 Crores in Q4, concentrated in BLG/SME; upgrade assumption for Q2/Q3 is key.
Margin pressure from bulk and CD funding (cost of funds about 6.5%); the NIM path depends on deposit repricing and CD rates easing.
Other income recovery depends on treasury gains (AFS book) and insurance and gold fee pick-up from Q2.
Gold regulation: end-use monitoring and the gold mix glide path from 54% toward 30% by FY2030.
Execution of the CASA/retail franchise, with CASA ratio expected to hold at 19.41% only if deposits grow about 25%.
Management said Q1 ROA of 1.09% is below the FY27 guidance of 1.3%-1.5%, so the run-rate must improve materially in later quarters.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the year-on-year numbers and guidance, but defensive on the quarter-on-quarter dip in NIM, ROA and other income, which it attributes to transient factors. Management was also candid about the delayed technology decision and avoided commenting on the IDBI Bank stake sale beyond saying it was not involved.
key_quotes: We will only improve from here.
I do not see liquidity as a risk for us in the near term.

Except for the technology which got delayed by around two-and-a-half years which was a decision point and not an execution point - almost everything else we achieved the way we had given guidance to the markets.

adds.what: Network of 868 branches and 835 ATMs as on 30 June 2026 (existing, no new branch additions quantified)
Trade, supply chain and CMS systems going live in next 3-4 months (technology, not productive capacity)

growth.why: Management guides FY27 NIM ~3.75%, ROA 1.3-1.5% and ROE ending above 14.14%, with wholesale growing 35-40% and gold 30-35%, backed by demand (deposits +26%, advances +24% YoY) and margin recovery from a Q1 trough, but no specific new capacity or order book quantified; Q1 operating profit +14% and net profit +27% YoY.
